title: Subquadratic launches with a $29M seed and debuts SubQ, an LLM that uses a subquadratic sparse attention architecture to achieve a 12M-token context window (Kyt Dotson/SiliconANGLE)
summary: Kyt Dotson / SiliconANGLE: Subquadratic launches with a $29M seed and debuts SubQ, an LLM that uses a subquadratic sparse attention architecture to achieve a 12M-token context window — Subquadratic, a company developing a novel generative artificial intelligence model, launched today with $29 million in seed funding.
